implementation.note: Phase logic retains boss identity across the addition of reinforcements.

architecture.note: Tick reads the durable values before spawning and resolves live ECS state at writeback. No second owner.

native_api.note: The existing Encounters native system drives both component storage modes in the regression.

skill.note: Boss encounter recipe includes the spawn tick and replay verification.

mcp.note: The existing match and scenario execution tools use the same simulation implementation. Registry and end-to-end match execution were exercised.

studio.note: This correctness repair does not introduce an authoring option or Studio workflow. Existing encounter rules retain their format.

inspector.note: No new inspectable property is introduced.

persistence.note: Snapshot, serialized and fresh simulation restores each matched all 80 checks starting at tick 300.

graphs.note: No graph data or evaluation changes.

performance.note: One 61-game-second boss_arena seed-2 Release run took 18 ms in the integrated test report. The fix uses scalar state and entity lookup; no new allocation in the tick.

platforms.note: macOS arm64 Release and x86_64 Debug exercised the transition. Windows and Linux were not independently executed.

dependencies.note: Uses the existing simulation World and Unit APIs; the tested native game requires no new module.

headless.note: The real headless host ran repeated seed-2 matches, three restore modes and the 96-case sample suite.

examples.note: Existing boss_arena exercises a reinforcement phase at tick 313 with seed 2.

tests.note: The native spawn-tick regression, 8 identical final states, 3 restore modes and 96 template cases passed.

handoff.note: The pre-fix and post-fix evidence and intentional baseline change are detailed in the checksum handoff.

documentation.note: Encounter guide and native workflow document the same-entity spawn transition.

publishing.note: The change fixes authoritative tick behavior and has no dedicated presentation surface.
